from pathlib import Path

FONT={
"T":["11111","00100","00100","00100","00100","00100","00100"],
"E":["11111","10000","10000","11110","10000","10000","11111"],
"S":["01111","10000","10000","01110","00001","00001","11110"],
"O":["01110","10001","10001","10001","10001","10001","01110"],
"C":["01111","10000","10000","10000","10000","10000","01111"],
"R":["11110","10001","10001","11110","10100","10010","10001"],
" ":["00000"]*7
}
text="TEST OCR TEST"
scale=12
margin=40
char_w=6*scale
w=margin*2+len(text)*char_w
h=margin*2+7*scale
pixels=bytearray([255])*(w*h)
for ci,ch in enumerate(text):
    glyph=FONT[ch]
    ox=margin+ci*char_w
    oy=margin
    for gy,row in enumerate(glyph):
        for gx,bit in enumerate(row):
            if bit!="1": continue
            for dy in range(scale):
                for dx in range(scale):
                    x=ox+gx*scale+dx
                    y=oy+gy*scale+dy
                    pixels[y*w+x]=0

# Embed raw grayscale pixels as the only page content. No PDF text operators exist.
content=f"q {w} 0 0 {h} 0 0 cm /Im0 Do Q".encode()
objects=[
 b"<< /Type /Catalog /Pages 2 0 R >>",
 b"<< /Type /Pages /Kids [3 0 R] /Count 1 >>",
 f"<< /Type /Page /Parent 2 0 R /MediaBox [0 0 {w} {h}] /Resources << /XObject << /Im0 5 0 R >> >> /Contents 4 0 R >>".encode(),
 b"<< /Length "+str(len(content)).encode()+b" >>\nstream\n"+content+b"\nendstream",
 f"<< /Type /XObject /Subtype /Image /Width {w} /Height {h} /ColorSpace /DeviceGray /BitsPerComponent 8 /Length {len(pixels)} >>".encode()+b"\nstream\n"+bytes(pixels)+b"\nendstream"
]
pdf=bytearray(b"%PDF-1.4\n")
offsets=[0]
for i,obj in enumerate(objects,1):
    offsets.append(len(pdf)); pdf.extend(f"{i} 0 obj\n".encode()); pdf.extend(obj); pdf.extend(b"\nendobj\n")
xref=len(pdf); pdf.extend(f"xref\n0 {len(objects)+1}\n".encode()); pdf.extend(b"0000000000 65535 f \n")
for off in offsets[1:]: pdf.extend(f"{off:010d} 00000 n \n".encode())
pdf.extend(f"trailer\n<< /Size {len(objects)+1} /Root 1 0 R >>\nstartxref\n{xref}\n%%EOF\n".encode())
out=Path("canonical/astra_runtime/tmp/IMAGE_ONLY_OCR_TEST.pdf")
out.write_bytes(pdf)
print("IMAGE_ONLY_PDF_READY",w,h,len(pdf))
